messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":3,"verses":[{"chapter":3,"verse":21,"text":"21 And when morning came, Jeremiah sent for Abimelech, saying: “Take a basket and go to the estate of Agrippa by the mountain road, and bring back some figs to give to the sick among the people, for the favor of the Lord is on you and his glory is on your head.”"},{"chapter":3,"verse":22,"text":"22 And when he had said this, Jeremiah sent him away, and Abimelech went as he told him."}],"book_code":"4BAR"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 21,22 in this chapter.
